$comment: ヒーローのポートレート（tools/portraits）を参照に、3D 生成（Tripo image-to-model）の入力にする全身 T ポーズ画像の仕様。tools/heroref/fullbody.py が読む。武器・副手・浮遊物・翼・光輪・発光は実行時に付けるので描かせない。体に付ける装着物（籠手・爪・機械の腕・背中の鐘・矢筒・背嚢）は wear に書き、本体に含める。年齢区分 9+ のため露出させない。
template: Full-body character reference image of the EXACT same character as in the attached portrait, for building a rigged 3D game model.
Keep identical: {keep}, and the overall color palette, materials and ornament style of the portrait.

Pose: strict T-pose, front orthographic view, perfectly symmetrical, standing upright. Both arms straight out horizontally at shoulder height, palms facing down, fingers together, hands empty. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart, the whole body from the top of the head (including any helmet, hat, crown or ears) to the soles of the feet visible with margin.

Costume adapted for 3D: {costume}. Sleeves are fitted to the arms down to the wrists with only short decorative cuffs: NO wide hanging sleeves and NO fabric hanging below the arms (the space under each arm must stay empty background). Any long hair falls straight down behind the back and does not cover the arms or hands. Each leg is clearly separate. Modest, fully covered outfit: no bare thighs, no bare midriff, no cleavage.
Remove completely: {remove}. The hands are empty. NO weapons, NO floating objects, NO magic effects, NO particles, NO glow aura.

Rendering: semi-realistic anime game art matching the portrait, heroic game proportions (head about 1/7 of the height), clean readable shapes, plain flat light-gray background, even soft lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no logo, single character only.
